notes:
What's new

- If an update ever stops WinPreview from starting, the app notices after a few attempts and offers to bring back the previous version in one click.
- The previous version is kept on your PC before every update, so restoring takes seconds and works without a connection.
- A restore also stops that release from being offered again, so you are only asked when something newer is available.
changelog: WinPreview 1.3.10 - automatic rollback. The build being replaced is backed up before every update, and a version that fails to start three times offers one-click restore of the previous one; the failed release is then hidden until a newer version ships.
